note: first v4-era baseline: JN-L re-pointed from v2 to databases/berkeley_housing_v4.db (2026-10-02). Fee layer = the City's own CapDetail Fees-tab TOTALS per master/phase permit and per Planning record, as of retrieval (not itemized); the small cohort = completed projects with <=2 units (replaces v2's id-block heuristic); assessor values = the snapshot v4 carries.

completed_projects.what_would_change_it: a building finaled / a CO ruling in the v4 build (projects stage)

completed_units.what_would_change_it: unit-count ruling or reading ruling on a completed building

assessor_matched.what_would_change_it: assessor re-ingest into v4 (re-plats resolve or appear) or a parcel-link change

adu_small_n.what_would_change_it: a small (<=2u) completion added, or a permit valuation newly recorded

adu_small_median_valuation.what_would_change_it: valuation corrections in the small cohort

adu_flag_units_completed.what_would_change_it: CPRA ADU field on a newly finaled master permit

vli_completed_units.what_would_change_it: affordability evidence added on completed projects

bp_fee_projects.what_would_change_it: a Fees-tab re-harvest (CapDetail) of master permits

planning_fee_projects.what_would_change_it: a Fees-tab re-harvest of Planning records

funding_projects.what_would_change_it: a funding-ledger row keyed to a project

itemized_fee_permits.what_would_change_it: a NEW dated permit_fees_*.csv snapshot (re-harvest) -> append a new baseline

itemized_fee_addresses.what_would_change_it: a NEW dated permit_fees_*.csv snapshot (re-harvest) -> append a new baseline

tracked_imps_m.what_would_change_it: County reassessment posts re-ingested into v4 (EXPECTED to rise: 1-2yr lag)

benchmark_per_unit_k.what_would_change_it: a larger project becomes fully enrolled (benchmark ratchets up)

bp_fees_paid_m.what_would_change_it: a Fees-tab re-harvest (the totals are as of retrieval and only grow)

bp_fees_outstanding_k.what_would_change_it: a Fees-tab re-harvest (balances paid down / new invoices)

bp_fees_paid_completed_m.what_would_change_it: a Fees-tab re-harvest or a building finaled

itemized_fee_total_k.what_would_change_it: a NEW dated permit_fees snapshot (re-harvest) -> append a new baseline

itemized_bp_max_k.what_would_change_it: a larger new-construction BP fee appears in a re-harvest -> append a new baseline

city_share_of_1pct.source: City of Berkeley revenue memo (AB-8 share): https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/legislative-body-meeting-attachments/Item%202%20Revenue%20and%20Transfers%20In%20FY%202021%20vs%20FY%202020%20Comparison.pdf

allocation_approx.source: City 32.57% exact (above); schools/county/special APPROXIMATE from AB-8 structure, Alameda Auditor-Controller glossary https://auditor.alamedacountyca.gov/tax-glossary/

ad_valorem_total_rate.source: approx total ad-valorem (1% base + voter debt levies ~0.23% city FY26 + school debt); the same 1.25% v4 v_projects.est_annual_tax_1pct_rule uses

city_debt_levy_rate.source: FY2026 City of Berkeley voter-approved ad-valorem debt rate 0.2323%, Dec-2-2025 staff report https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/documents/2025-12-02%20Special%20Item%2002%20Discussion%20Regarding%20Potential%20Ballot.pdf

gf_revenues_fy27_m.source: PROPOSED FY27 GF revenues, May-14-2026 budget presentation slide 25 https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/legislative-body-meeting-attachments/5.14.26%20Item2%20FY%2027%20-%20FY%2028%20PROPOSED%20BIENNIAL%20BUDGET%20-%20Presentation.pdf

gf_spend_fy27_m.source: PROPOSED FY27 GF spend by department, May-14-2026 presentation slide 26 (same URL)

measure_o.source: 2018 Measure O affordable-housing GO bond + Measure P transfer tax; Dec-2-2025 staff report (URL above)

estimation_params.note: assumptions for the full-enrollment estimate — parameters, not measurements
estimation_params.enrolled_at_cost_floor: declared permit valuation is the FLOOR of what the assessor enrolls
estimation_params.benchmark_rule: MEDIAN Imps/unit among tracked completed projects >=100 units (John, 2026-10-03); the max is reported as the high end
estimation_params.small_cohort_rule: completed projects with <= 2 units use declared JobValuation, not parcel Imps (the pre-existing house dominates the parcel)
